investigation_notes.Description: An unusual volume of SharePoint file downloads (250) was observed from the user, well above the 24-hour baseline of 20. The activity includes sample files such as invoices and contracts and originates from Vilnius, Lithuania, via SharePoint Online. Given the large delta from baseline and potential exposure of sensitive documents, this alert is treated as high priority and requires further investigation to determine legitimacy and check for data leakage or credential misuse.
